title: H3XY/AGI: quantum text classifier with fair classical baselines and IBM hardware study
description: Code, data pipelines, result files and IBM Quantum job identifiers for the classical-data part of "Where Small Quantum Classifiers Help, and Where They Don't: Fair Baselines and Real-Hardware Results on IBM Heron": a 4-qubit data re-uploading classifier on sentence embeddings (sentiment, CVE severity), tuned classical baselines, a pre-registered confirmatory evaluation on untouched data, a circuit-design ablation, and a 200-input hardware study on ibm_marrakesh with exact shot-noise statistics, plus a cross-device replication on ibm_kingston and ibm_fez.
